overview_description.description: Luminate is an oncology-focused healthtech and tech-enabled services company that partners with payers, providers, and people with cancer to reduce the cost of cancer care while improving quality of life and outcomes for patients. The company offers a portfolio of services and technologies that enable home-based cancer treatment, adverse event monitoring, and prevention of drug-induced side effects.

about_short_description.short_description: Luminate is an oncology tech-enabled services company focused on reducing the cost of cancer care.

product.name: Lily
product.description: A therapy in development designed to prevent chemotherapy-induced hair loss using low-level compression on the scalp.

product.name: Lilac
product.description: An early-stage therapy designed to prevent chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy using low-level compression on hands and feet.

product.name: Lotus
product.description: A subcutaneous port access device designed to enable home infusions and blood draws for low-risk cancer treatments.
